title: Cave Painting
statementMd:
Imp is watching a documentary about cave painting.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8ec8a9fff94ac26b2c760e63823e96e9e224b87b.png)

Some numbers, carved in chaotic order, immediately attracted his attention. Imp rapidly proposed a guess that they are the remainders of division of a number $*n*$ by all integers $*i*$ from $1$ to $*k*$. Unfortunately, there are too many integers to analyze for Imp.

Imp wants you to check whether all these remainders are distinct. Formally, he wants to check, if all ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/af9bf37ade74cbe9830bd367f7c2aeaf738ffd73.png), $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *k*$, are distinct, i. e. there is no such pair $(*i*, *j*)$ that:

- $1 ≤ *i* < *j* ≤ *k*$,
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2e5b79d0b20795f51610e384d5973d0a2a091dd.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd0226f6733233da1ba1f4844ccc38fcceb2fd37.png) is the remainder of division $*x*$ by $*y*$.

## Input

The only line contains two integers $*n*$, $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 10^{18})$.

## Output

Print "`Yes`", if all the remainders are distinct, and "`No`" otherwise.

You can print each letter in arbitrary case (lower or upper).

## Note

In the first sample remainders modulo $1$ and $4$ coincide.
statementZhMd:
Imp 正在观看一部关于洞穴壁画的纪录片。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8ec8a9fff94ac26b2c760e63823e96e9e224b87b.png)

一些以混乱顺序刻下的数字立刻吸引了他的注意。Imp 很快猜测，这些数字是某个数字 $*n*$ 除以从 $1$ 到 $*k*$ 的所有整数 $*i*$ 所得到的余数。不幸的是，要分析的整数太多了，Imp 无法一一处理。

Imp 希望你检查所有这些余数是否互不相同。形式化地说，他想检查对于所有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/af9bf37ade74cbe9830bd367f7c2aeaf738ffd73.png)，$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *k*$，它们是否互不相同，即不存在满足以下条件的二元组 $(*i*, *j*)$：

- $1 ≤ *i* < *j* ≤ *k*$；
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2e5b79d0b20795f51610e384d5973d0a2a091dd.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd0226f6733233da1ba1f4844ccc38fcceb2fd37.png) 表示 $*x*$ 除以 $*y*$ 所得的余数。

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 10^{18}$）。

## 输出格式

如果所有余数都互不相同，输出 `Yes`；否则输出 `No`。

每个字母可以使用任意大小写形式输出。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，模 $1$ 和模 $4$ 的余数相同。
